SorgAnX is an organ and saxophone duo founded in October 2019.

Since then, the musicians have performed at music festivals across Poland, including Bydgoszcz, Toruń, Kraków, Tarnów, Gdynia and Jelenia Góra.

Their repertoire ranges from Baroque transcriptions to a rich selection of contemporary works, with particular emphasis on promoting Polish composers such as Dariusz Przybylski, Miłosz Bembinow and Marian Sawa.

About us

Michał Dzięcioł

Organ

Graduate of the Feliks Nowowiejski Academy of Music in Bydgoszcz, with honors in the organ class of Prof. Radosław Marzec and Prof. Piotr Grajter. Prize-winner at national and international competitions, and has taken part in master classes with leading European organists including Jan Vermeire, Francis Jacob, and Andrzej Chorosiński. Combines a teaching career with solo recitals and the SorgAnX duo.

Mikołaj Sarad

Saxophone

Doctoral student at the Feliks Nowowiejski Academy of Music in Bydgoszcz under dr hab. Włodzimierz Spodymek. Winner of more than a dozen prizes at national and international instrumental and chamber music competitions, also recognized as a composer. Member of the Bydgoszcz Composers' Collective, with whom he released the debut album "Jazz for Mr Ives, Jazz for Mr Serocki" in 2023.

Repertoire

The duo's repertoire includes works of a diverse nature, including transcriptions of Baroque music, richly represented works by contemporary composers and many others.
